scope: Paired same-capacity supervised conditional-return prediction diagnostic, not asymmetric policy gradient, not a deployable privileged actor and not playing-strength evidence. Original warm actor generates all data; live-dark identity planes are training-only.
limitations: Conditional terminal-return prediction, not an actor update or playing-strength gain.
History-omitting observer features plus live-dark identity labels are not a full history-state critic.
Only one training seed; test uncertainty is clustered by whole game, not positions.
Both critics are training-only artifacts with incompatible input contracts for ordinary playing actors.
